physics_rule.description: Rule-based: expected function from angle/position thresholds

key_finding: RF achieves R²=-12.878 vs lag-1 AR R²=0.652. If lag-1 AR were close to RF, the model would mainly be doing temporal smoothing. The small gap (Δ=-13.530) raises concerns that the physical features contribute meaningful predictive information beyond temporal autocorrelation.
